detect_aruco_markers: detect ArUco markers in an image and return their IDs, corners, and estimated poses
estimate_single_marker_pose: estimate the 3D pose of a specific registered ArUco marker from an image
calibrate_camera_charuco: calibrate camera intrinsics using a set of images of a ChArUco board
render_detected_markers: render detected ArUco marker edges, IDs, and 3D axes onto an image
set_camera_intrinsics: set camera intrinsics from a CameraIntrinsics object, a 3x3 matrix, or keyword arguments
